entries.purpose: BSC010N04LS6 surrogate fitted to datasheet curves
entries.caveat: package Ld/Ls are estimates; PGD law and temperature not calibrated; not vendor-signed

entries.purpose: older v2 sequencing, still used by the cold-start decks
entries.caveat: superseded by v3 for SR decisions; v2 and v3 numbers must not be combined

entries.purpose: sr_timing_v2.lib with Cgate 6.7n -> 100p, for real-device benches only
entries.caveat: A/B artifact: identical to v2 except the lumped gate capacitor, so the only variable against sr_timing_v3_* is the state machine; not a model revision

typ thresholds only; uncalibrated PGD law; 128/46 ns gate edges vs 23/35 ns typ; standby, VSS offset current and adaptive 155/275 ns delay not implemented; the 6.7 nF gate surrogate is a known open driver-model defect (review P1); off-blank starts at max(Q falling edge, VD>ARM), conservative in the fast-rise case

entries.purpose: sr_timing_v3.lib plus the CGATE/CPIN gate-load parameters
entries.caveat: defaults reproduce v3 exactly; uncalibrated PGD law, typ thresholds only

entries.purpose: sr_timing_v3_1.lib plus a soft rail on the off-blank integrator
entries.caveat: numerical robustness only, but its turn-off comparator latches one drain ring peak above OFFTH and cuts the SR off after the on-blank on a real tank; see sr_timing_v3_3.lib and design/v2/sr_tank_dual_results.md -- do not take SR conduction numbers from it

entries.purpose: sr_timing_v3_2.lib with the turn-off comparator latch removed (v2 semantics restored)
entries.caveat: typ thresholds only; uncalibrated PGD law; the OFFTH turn-off now needs TOFF of continuous reverse-drain bias instead of one ringing peak; still not vendor-signed

entries.purpose: copy of sr_timing_v3.lib plus a behavioural 330 uA VSS offset equivalent
entries.caveat: the offset network is an equivalent, not a VSS-pin model; the gate loop still returns to S

entries.purpose: UCC25600 controller behaviour: oscillator, soft start, OC comparator, dual gate outputs
entries.caveat: bootstrap and bias are behavioural; no real bias/enable sequencing circuit

entries.purpose: UCC27282 gate driver from datasheet SNVSAQ5B: UVLO, EN timing, 16 ns TPD, 3 A/4 ohm drive
entries.caveat: no gate-charge or Qg model (the load is the timing model's lumped CGATE, review item 6.7 nF); delay matching, minimum pulse width and bootstrap reverse recovery not modelled

entries.status_note: hierarchical .op probe; not a transient benchmark
